answer.room: A long, narrow, empty living room in a contemporary minimalist style: white walls, an exposed gray concrete ceiling, light oak laminate floor, white baseboards, and a black aluminum sliding door to a balcony at the end, with a palette of white, cement gray, light wood and black.

pieces.piece: a sofa against the long left wall, facing the TV
pieces.why: It is the heart of a room for watching TV. A clean-lined sofa in a warm gray or sand fabric softens the concrete and white walls without weighing down a narrow room.
pieces.query:
Type: sofa, three-seat upholstered
Use: watching TV and lounging; living room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric, light wood or black metal legs
Colors: warm light gray, sand beige
Shape: low and straight, slim arms, raised legs, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, calm, clean
Goes with: white walls, concrete ceiling, light oak floor, black window frames; minimalist living room

pieces.piece: a table for eating, in front of the sofa or near the balcony end of the room
pieces.why: The client wants to eat while watching TV. A light oak table with black details matches the floor and the window frame, and the long room has space either in front of the sofa or as a small dining spot by the light.
pieces.query:
Type: table, light wood with simple base
Use: eating and setting down food and drinks; living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: light oak wood, black metal
Colors: natural light oak, black
Shape: rectangular or rounded, slim legs, clean lines, light visual weight
Feel: warm, simple, practical
Goes with: light oak floor, black window frames, white walls; contemporary living room

pieces.piece: a low TV stand against the long right wall, across from the sofa
pieces.why: It holds the television at eye level from the sofa, uses the outlets on that wall, and keeps the narrow room clear with a shallow, low profile.
pieces.query:
Type: TV stand, low media console
Use: holding the TV and storing media; living room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: light oak wood, matte white or black metal
Colors: natural light oak, white, black accents
Shape: long and low, shallow, closed doors or drawers, light visual weight
Feel: tidy, light, modern
Goes with: white walls, light oak floor, concrete ceiling, black window frames

pieces.piece: a rug between the sofa and the TV stand
pieces.why: It defines the TV area within the long room and adds warmth and texture over the laminate floor, in soft neutrals that sit well with the concrete and oak.
pieces.query:
Type: rug, flat woven or low pile
Use: defining the seating area; living room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, Japandi
Materials: wool, jute or cotton blend
Colors: ivory, warm gray, sand
Shape: rectangular, subtle texture or faint pattern, low profile
Feel: soft, warm, calm
Goes with: light oak floor, gray sofa, white walls, concrete ceiling

pieces.piece: a floor lamp beside the sofa
pieces.why: The room has only a bare bulb, so a floor lamp gives warm, soft light for watching TV, and black metal echoes the balcony door frame.
pieces.query:
Type: floor lamp, slim with shade
Use: ambient reading and TV light; living room
Style: minimalist, industrial, Scandinavian
Materials: black metal, linen or fabric shade
Colors: matte black, off-white
Shape: tall and slender, small base, light visual weight
Feel: warm, soft, understated
Goes with: black window frames, concrete ceiling, white walls, light oak floor

pieces.piece: sheer curtains on the balcony sliding door
pieces.why: They soften the bare window, filter the glare on the TV screen, and add a light textile layer that finishes the room.
pieces.query:
Type: curtains, sheer linen panels
Use: filtering light and softening the window; living room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, Japandi
Materials: linen, light woven fabric
Colors: off-white, warm natural
Shape: floor length, straight fall, light visual weight
Feel: airy, soft, calm
Goes with: white walls, black window frame, light oak floor, concrete ceiling
